 Weather remains unsettled today as nor'easter exits New England 
 Temperatures could reach the 60s by the end of next week! 
 By Dominic Brown • 
 Published November 14, 2026 • 
 Updated on November 14, 2026 at 11:29 pm 
 BOOKMARKER 
 NBC Universal, Inc. 
 We’re expecting the rest of the weekend to be chilly, but temperatures are expected to warm up next week.
 The November nor’easter that’s had its grip over Boston the past couple of days will continue moving slowly to the northeast this weekend. But as it continues tracking away from New England, the flow around the system will keep our weather a bit unsettled, especially today. 
 In fact, we’ll see some sunshine this morning, but by this afternoon, clouds will increase and thicken, giving way to a few spotty rain showers and potentially a couple of snowflakes in the higher elevations toward the Berkshires, Vermont and New Hampshire. It will be a chilly day, too, with high temperatures in the mid 40s.
 Stream NBC10 Boston news for free, 24/7, wherever you are.
   WATCH HERE 
 NBC10 Boston NBC10 Boston 
 Tonight, the clouds will hang around, but no rain is expected. Overnight low temperatures will dip into the 20s and 30s.
 We’ll start our Sunday with temperatures in the 30s. By afternoon, high temperatures will climb into the upper 40s. It might feel colder at times though. Winds will blow in from the northwest, gusting up to 25-30 mph. We’re expecting mostly sunny skies.
 Next week, get ready for a sunny stretch! We’re tracking plenty of sun, in fact, starting on Monday. High temperatures will also be warming up through the week.  
 Highs on Monday will be in the low 50s. By mid to late week, a big warmup arrives. Highs on Thursday and Friday will be in the low to mid 60s!
 Have a great weekend!
